en-US.author: Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd.
en-US.description: Desktop application for DeepSeek Harness, an open-source agent harness
en-US.longDescription: DeepSeek Harness is the desktop application for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), an open-source agent harness developed by DeepSeek AI. It bundles the dsh runtime in an Electron desktop shell and hosts the dsh Web UI locally, so agents can work with files, terminals, browsers, models, and plugins through an everything-is-a-plugin architecture.
en-US.name: DeepSeek Harness
en-US.publisher: Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd.

zh-CN.author: 杭州深度求索人工智能基础技术研究有限公司
zh-CN.description: 由 DeepSeek AI 开发的开源智能体框架 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面应用
zh-CN.longDescription: DeepSeek Harness Nightly 是 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的桌面应用。dsh 是由 DeepSeek AI 开发的开源智能体框架，构建于「一切皆插件」的架构之上。应用将 dsh 运行时打包进 Electron 桌面外壳，并在本地提供 dsh Web UI，智能体可以在其中操作文件、终端、浏览器、模型和插件。Nightly 渠道提供快速迭代的开发者预览版本，可能包含破坏兼容性的变更。
